title: Space Police
description: Run an Intcode-powered hull-painting robot that reads panel colors and paints a registration identifier.
writeup:
## Approach

The robot is a simple state machine: position, direction, and a dictionary of painted panels. The Intcode brain reads the current panel color as input and outputs two values: the color to paint and which way to turn. After turning, the robot steps forward.

Using `run_until_block()` lets the Intcode program pause naturally when it needs input, making the robot loop straightforward.

## Part 1

Start on a black panel (color 0). Run the robot until the Intcode program halts. Count how many unique panel positions were painted at least once — the size of the panels dictionary.

## Part 2

Start on a white panel (color 1) instead. The robot now paints eight capital letters as a registration identifier. Render the white panels as a grid to read the message.
